name: Rome Cavalieri
insider_take: Perched on Monte Mario, Rome's highest hill, this palatial retreat offers sweeping views of the Eternal City while housing one of Europe's most impressive private art collections.
whats_special: The hotel boasts over 1,000 original artworks including pieces by Tiepolo and Warhol, plus Rome's only 3-Michelin-starred restaurant, La Pergola. The 15-acre Mediterranean park creates an oasis just 15 minutes from the Vatican, while the Imperial Club spa features the city's largest indoor pool.
pro_tip: Book a sunset aperitivo on the hotel's terrace for unparalleled panoramic views of St. Peter's Dome and the Roman skyline - it's considered one of the most romantic spots in Rome.
dont_miss: The complimentary shuttle to Via Veneto and Spanish Steps, the hotel's private helipad for VIP arrivals, and the legendary Sunday brunch at L'Uliveto restaurant overlooking the gardens and cityscape.
pros: Breathtaking panoramic views of Rome and St. Peter's Basilica from a private hilltop setting above the city
Home to one of Rome's finest fine-dining experiences at La Pergola, the city's only three-Michelin-starred restaurant
World-class art collection featuring over 600 original artworks, including rare tapestries and masterpieces displayed throughout the property
Expansive resort-style amenities including three outdoor pools, a full-service spa, and lush Mediterranean parkland gardens spanning 15 acres
Impeccable Waldorf Astoria service with spacious, elegantly appointed rooms and suites offering exceptional luxury and comfort
cons: Secluded hilltop location requires a taxi or shuttle to reach Rome's historic city center attractions
Ultra-luxury pricing places this property at the top tier of Rome's hotel market, best suited for special occasion travelers
